verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API introduction says outright that users can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec for their own tooling, so the product itself provides this capability. The probe's 404s only covered guessed well-known paths, which does not contradict the documented download. missing for 10: a documented download URL or location for the spec, details on spec version and coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.
Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API.
